scope: Exact monomial padding including propagating relations, all-field univariate padding for arbitrary finite quotients, and an infinite-family obstruction to absolute-divisor-volume reuse charges. Intermediate primitive costs and near-full common face cores are retained. Independent socle fans remain subgeneric; no unrestricted G3 improvement, polynomial lower separation, or novelty established.
